```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, dpi = 160)
output_dir <- params$output_dir
read_output <- function(...) {
  readr::read_csv(file.path(output_dir, ...), show_col_types = FALSE)
}
audit <- read_output("tables", "data_audit.csv")
column_map <- read_output("tables", "column_map.csv")
missingness <- read_output("tables", "missingness.csv")
replication <- read_output("tables", "species_replication.csv")
trait_coverage <- read_output("audit", "trait_coverage.csv")
experiments <- read_output("audit", "experiment_audit.csv")
validation <- read_output("audit", "pre_model_validation.csv")
metric <- function(horizon, name) {
  value <- audit$value[audit$horizon == horizon & audit$metric == name]
  if (length(value) != 1L) NA_real_ else value[[1]]
}
fmt <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  if (digits == 0) {
    format(round(x), scientific = FALSE, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
  } else {
    formatC(x, digits = digits, format = "fg", big.mark = ",")
  }
}
embed_png <- function(path, alt) {
  knitr::asis_output(sprintf(
    '<img src="%s" alt="%s" style="width:100%%;height:auto;"/>',
    knitr::image_uri(path), alt
  ))
}
```

table {font-size: 0.92em;}

<div class="audit-ok">
This checkpoint was written before covariance reconstruction or hierarchical model fitting. All `r nrow(validation)` blocking validation checks passed. Trait gaps and partial reviewed climate-context coverage are documented but were not treated as fatal errors.
</div>

# Audit overview

The inferential response is the continuous raw warmed-minus-origin AUC contrast. It was not defined or filtered using winner/loser labels or statistical-significance categories.

| Audit quantity | Maximum duration | First 3 years |
|:--|--:|--:|
| Effect rows | `r fmt(metric("max", "total_effect_rows"), 0)` | `r fmt(metric("3", "total_effect_rows"), 0)` |
| Unique species × experiment combinations | `r fmt(metric("max", "species_experiment_combinations"), 0)` | `r fmt(metric("3", "species_experiment_combinations"), 0)` |
| Unique species | `r fmt(metric("max", "unique_species"), 0)` | `r fmt(metric("3", "unique_species"), 0)` |
| Experiments | `r fmt(metric("max", "experiments"), 0)` | `r fmt(metric("3", "experiments"), 0)` |
| Gradients/studies | `r fmt(metric("max", "gradients_studies"), 0)` | `r fmt(metric("3", "gradients_studies"), 0)` |
| Positive finite SEs | `r fmt(metric("max", "positive_finite_SE"), 0)` | `r fmt(metric("3", "positive_finite_SE"), 0)` |

```{r audit-effect-figure, results='asis'}
embed_png(
  file.path(output_dir, "audit", "figures", "effect_and_biological_coverage.png"),
  "Response direction, repeated-species frequency, and trait coverage before model fitting."
)
```

*Response direction, repeated-species frequency, and trait coverage before model fitting.*

# Response and uncertainty

| Quantity | Maximum duration | First 3 years |
|:--|--:|--:|
| AUC minimum | `r fmt(metric("max", "auc_effect_minimum"))` | `r fmt(metric("3", "auc_effect_minimum"))` |
| AUC median | `r fmt(metric("max", "auc_effect_median"))` | `r fmt(metric("3", "auc_effect_median"))` |
| AUC maximum | `r fmt(metric("max", "auc_effect_maximum"))` | `r fmt(metric("3", "auc_effect_maximum"))` |
| Negative / zero / positive | `r paste(fmt(metric("max", "negative_auc_effects"), 0), fmt(metric("max", "zero_auc_effects"), 0), fmt(metric("max", "positive_auc_effects"), 0), sep=" / ")` | `r paste(fmt(metric("3", "negative_auc_effects"), 0), fmt(metric("3", "zero_auc_effects"), 0), fmt(metric("3", "positive_auc_effects"), 0), sep=" / ")` |
| SE minimum–maximum | `r paste(fmt(metric("max", "auc_se_minimum")), fmt(metric("max", "auc_se_maximum")), sep=" – ")` | `r paste(fmt(metric("3", "auc_se_minimum")), fmt(metric("3", "auc_se_maximum")), sep=" – ")` |

# Experiment and design coverage

Climate and design summaries give each distinct experiment equal weight. Precipitation is displayed in its raw source units here; the model uses its natural logarithm.

```{r audit-experiment-figure, results='asis'}
embed_png(
  file.path(output_dir, "audit", "figures", "experiment_and_design_coverage.png"),
  "Observed climate, duration, area, and plot replication at the experiment level."
)
```

*Observed climate, duration, area, and plot replication at the experiment level.*

```{r experiment-ranges}
range_rows <- audit |>
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$horizon == "max",
    .data$metric %in% c(
      "T_minimum", "T_maximum", "P_raw_minimum", "P_raw_maximum",
      "W_minimum", "W_maximum", "duration_minimum", "duration_maximum",
      "integration_span_minimum", "integration_span_maximum",
      "plot_area_minimum", "plot_area_maximum",
      "origin_plots_minimum", "origin_plots_maximum",
      "warmed_plots_minimum", "warmed_plots_maximum"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(value = signif(.data$value, 5))
knitr::kable(range_rows[, c("metric", "value")], col.names = c("Primary-horizon range component", "Value"))
```

# Missingness and trait coverage

```{r audit-missingness-figure, results='asis'}
embed_png(
  file.path(output_dir, "audit", "figures", "inferential_field_missingness.png"),
  "Missingness across all inferential fields; focal traits have incomplete coverage."
)
```

*Missingness across all inferential fields. Core response, uncertainty, identifiers, climate, and design fields are complete; focal traits have incomplete coverage.*

```{r trait-coverage-table}
trait_display <- trait_coverage |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$horizon == "max") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    effect_coverage = scales::percent(.data$effect_coverage, accuracy = 0.1),
    species_coverage = scales::percent(.data$species_coverage, accuracy = 0.1)
  )
knitr::kable(trait_display, caption = "Primary-horizon trait coverage.")
```
